name: Silverstone Circuit
summary: A former airfield that held the first World Championship race and still has some of F1's fastest corners.
character: Fast and flowing. Copse, Maggotts, Becketts and Stowe reward downforce and commitment, and the wind across the old airfield changes how the car handles from lap to lap.

layouts.name: Arena layout, old pits
factNotes: 5.901 km in 2010, the first year of the Arena section; the race dropped from 60 to 52 laps. Moving the start line to the new pits in 2011 gave 5.891 km.

corners.name: Copse
corners.note: A right-hander taken flat out at close to 300 km/h.

corners.name: Maggotts and Becketts
corners.note: Left-right-left-right at very high speed. Where a good car shows itself.

moments.title: Hamilton by over a minute
moments.body: In heavy rain in 2008, Lewis Hamilton won by more than a minute and lapped everyone but the drivers who finished second and third.

history.body: First British Grand Prix at the old wartime airfield.
Hosted the first ever World Championship race.
Became the permanent home of the British GP.
New pit building, the Wing, and today's 5.891 km layout.
